_doc: hotel.sc data. Every coordinate the app needs lives here (the .sc is generic, published open-source).
Coordinates: door = the LOWER door cell [x,-9,z] (facing into the corridor); the upper half is door.y+1 — the app
reads facing/hinge live off the block itself (block()+block_state()) and never hardcodes them, so it survives the
box = the suite's interior (min/max inclusive), used for the 'anyone inside = door open, never locked in' rule and
the check-in welcome message. spawn = the bed-side cell offered as 'Make it my respawn point' (spawnpoint).
plaque = a text_display beside the door on the CORRIDOR face (SPEC 4): west doors (wall x=-67) sit at x=-65.97,
viewers face east so yaw=-90; east doors (wall x=-61) sit at x=-61.03, viewers face west so yaw=90. z = door.z+1.5
plaque = a text_display beside the door on the CORRIDOR face, one block EAST of the door (x = door.x + 1.5), y=-7.5:
north suites (wall z=-111, corridor face z=-110.0) → z=-109.97, viewers south → yaw 0;
south suites (wall z=-107, corridor face z=-107.0) → z=-107.03, viewers north → yaw 180. Suite name + free/taken, never the guest's name.
checkout_days: a guest not 'seen' (online) for this many days is auto-checked-out on start and every 20 minutes.
Layout: a pool on the west facade; 3 north + 3 south suites around an east-west corridor.
rooms[].facing = the iron door's facing (into the corridor); the app re-places a missing door from it.
lobby_spawn = where a player's respawn point goes when it sits in a suite that is no longer theirs (check-out, leaving, 7-day timeout, or on join).
name: The Hideaway
